mapper.sql: id, kind, user_id, applicant_tg_id, applicant_tg_username, status, disputed, disputed_at, dispute_pin_ok, dispute_frozen, objection_ends_at, proof_note, approved_by, approved_at, execute_at, revoke_requested_by, revoke_requested_at, closed_by, close_reason, closed_at, created_at
mapper.select: SELECT p.first_name, p.middle_name, p.last_name, (SELECT k.status FROM account_kyc_application k WHERE k.user_id = u.id ORDER BY k.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS kyc_status, (SELECT k.doc_number FROM account_kyc_application k WHERE k.user_id = u.id ORDER BY k.id DESC LIMIT 1) AS doc_number FROM account_user u LEFT JOIN account_profile p ON p.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_recovery (kind, user_id, applicant_tg_id, applicant_tg_username, status, objection_ends_at, created_at) VALUES (#{kind}, #{userId}, #{applicantTgId}, #{applicantTgUsername}, #{status}, #{objectionEndsAt}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM account_recovery WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM account_recovery WHERE user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_recovery WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status IN ('OBJECTION', 'PROOF', 'APPROVED')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_recovery WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND kind = #{kind} AND created_at >= #{since}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_recovery_attempt WHERE applicant_tg_id = #{tgId} AND created_at >= #{since}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_recovery_ban (kind, value, until_at, recovery_id, created_at) VALUES (#{kind}, #{value}, #{until}, #{recoveryId}, #{at})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM account_recovery_ban WHERE kind = #{kind} AND value = #{value} AND until_at > #{now}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO account_recovery_event (recovery_id, action, actor, note, created_at) VALUES (#{recoveryId}, #{action}, #{actor}, #{note}, #{at})
mapper.select: SELECT action, actor, note, created_at AS at FROM account_recovery_event WHERE recovery_id = #{recoveryId} ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE account_recovery SET status = #{to} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from}
UPDATE account_recovery SET disputed = 1, disputed_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id} AND disputed = 0
UPDATE account_recovery SET dispute_pin_ok = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE account_recovery SET dispute_frozen = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE account_recovery SET status = 'APPROVED', approved_by = #{adminId}, approved_at = #{at}, proof_note = #{note}, execute_at = #{executeAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROOF'
UPDATE account_recovery SET revoke_requested_by = #{by}, revoke_requested_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'APPROVED'
UPDATE account_recovery SET revoke_requested_by = NULL, revoke_requested_at = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'APPROVED'
UPDATE account_recovery SET status = #{to}, closed_by = #{by}, close_reason = #{reason}, closed_at = #{at} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = #{from}
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM account_recovery WHERE status = 'OBJECTION' AND objection_ends_at <= #{now} ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM account_recovery WHERE status IN ('OBJECTION', 'PROOF', 'APPROVED') AND disputed = 1 AND dispute_pin_ok = 0 AND dispute_frozen = 0 AND disputed_at <= #{before} ORDER BY id
SELECT id FROM account_recovery WHERE status = 'APPROVED' AND execute_at <= #{now} AND revoke_requested_by IS NULL ORDER BY id
